definition_en: to cause something to happen
example_en: The new policy brought about significant improvements in the healthcare system.
example_uz: Yangi siyosat sog'liqni saqlash tizimida sezilarli yaxshilanishlarni yuzaga keltirdi.
example_ru: Новая политика привела к значительным улучшениям в системе здравоохранения.
word_family: bring about
common_mistake: 'Bring about' va 'bring up' iboralarini chalkashtirmang; 'bring about' natija yoki o'zgarishni yuzaga keltirishni bildiradi.

definition_en: to perform or complete a task, instruction, or research
example_en: Scientists will carry out further experiments to confirm the findings.
example_uz: Olimlar xulosalarni tasdiqlash uchun qo'shimcha tajribalar o'tkazishadi.
example_ru: Ученые проведут дополнительные эксперименты, чтобы подтвердить выводы.
word_family: carry out
common_mistake: 'Carry out' iborasini so'zma-so'z 'ko'tarib chiqmoq' deb tushunmang; u vazifa yoki tajribani bajarishni anglatadi.

definition_en: to take strong or severe action to stop illegal or unacceptable behaviour
example_en: The council decided to crack down on illegal parking in the city centre.
example_uz: Kengash shahar markazida noqonuniy avtoturargohlarga qarshi qat'iy choralar ko'rishga qaror qildi.
example_ru: Совет решил принять жесткие меры против незаконной парковки в центре города.
word_family: crackdown (noun)
common_mistake: 'Crack down' fe'lidan so'ng ob'ekt kelganda 'on' predlogi ishlatiladi ('crack down on'), 'for' deyish xatodir.

translation_uz: kutilmaganda yuzaga kelmoq, to'satdan paydo bo'lmoq
definition_en: to happen or appear unexpectedly
example_en: A few unexpected problems cropped up during the negotiations.
example_uz: Muzokaralar davomida bir nechta kutilmagan muammolar yuzaga keldi.
example_ru: Во время переговоров возникло несколько неожиданных проблем.
word_family: crop up (verb)
common_mistake: Ushbu fe'l o'timli emas (intransitive), shuning uchun unga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri to'ldiruvchi elanib bo'lmaydi.

definition_en: to continue for a longer time than necessary or expected in a boring or tiring way
example_en: The court case dragged on for almost two years.
example_uz: Sud ishi deyarli ikki yil cho'zilib ketdi.
example_ru: Судебное разбирательство затянулось почти на два года.
word_family: drag on (verb)
common_mistake: 'Drag on' jarayon yoki majlislar uchun ishlatiladi, inson obyekt sifatidagida emas.

definition_en: to fail to happen or be completed successfully
example_en: Our holiday plans fell through because of the flight cancellations.
example_uz: Parvozlar bekor qilingani sababli dam olish rejalarimiz barbod bo'ldi.
example_ru: Наши планы на отпуск сорвались из-за отмены рейсов.
word_family: fall through (verb)
common_mistake: 'Fall through' majhul nisbatda (passive voice) ishlatilmaydi; 'was fallen through' deyish xatodir.

translation_uz: hal qilmoq, kelishib olmoq, bartaraf etmoq
definition_en: to resolve or remove small difficulties, doubts, or details
example_en: We need to iron out a few final details before signing the contract.
example_uz: Shartnomani imzolashdan oldin bir nechta so'nggi tafsilotlarni hal qilib olishimiz kerak.
example_ru: Нам нужно уладить несколько последних деталей перед подписанием контракта.
word_family: iron out (verb)
common_mistake: Kiyim dazmollash ma'nosi ham bor bo'lib, ko'chma ma'nosi muammolarni hal qilish ekanligini unutmaslik kerak.

definition_en: to reduce the number of possibilities or choices
example_en: We have narrowed down the list of candidates to just three people.
example_uz: Biz nomzodlar ro'yxatini atigi uch kishigacha qisqartirdik.
example_ru: Мы сократили список кандидатов всего до трех человек.
word_family: narrow down (verb)
common_mistake: Natijani ko'rsatishda 'to' predlogi ishlatiladi ('narrow down to three'), 'into' emas.

translation_ru: постепенно сворачивать, постепенно выводить из употребления
definition_en: to stop using or providing something gradually in stages
example_en: The government plans to phase out single-use plastics by next year.
example_uz: Hukumat kelasi yilgacha bir marta ishlatiladigan plastikni bosqichma-bosqich bekor qilishni rejalashtirmoqda.
example_ru: Правительство планирует постепенно вывести из употребления одноразовый пластик к следующему году.
word_family: phase-out (noun)
common_mistake: 'Phase out' bir lahzada to'xtatishni emas, balki bosqichma-bosqich jarayonni anglatadi.

definition_en: to gradually decrease in effect, intensity, or feeling
example_en: The pain relief medication began to wear off after a few hours.
example_uz: Bir necha soatdan keyin og'riqsizlantiruvchi dorining ta'siri kamaya boshladi.
example_ru: Обезболивающее средство начало проходить через несколько часов.
word_family: wear off (verb)
common_mistake: 'Wear off' (ta'siri yo'qolishi) va 'wear out' (eskirib to'zish yoki juda charchash) chalkashtirilmasligi kerak.

definition_en: to explain something clearly and in explicit detail
example_en: You do not need to spell out every detail; I understand the situation.
example_uz: Har bir tafsilotni batafsil tushuntirishingiz shart emas; men vaziyatni tushunib turibman.
example_ru: Вам не нужно подробно объяснять каждую деталь; я понимаю ситуацию.
word_family: spell out (verb)
common_mistake: Bu ibora ko'chma ma'noda aniq tushuntirishni anglatadi, shunchaki harflab aytishni emas.

definition_en: to resign or leave a position of authority or responsibility
example_en: The chief executive decided to step down following the scandal.
example_uz: Bosh ijrochi direktor mojarodan so'ng lavozimidan ketishga qaror qildi.
example_ru: Генеральный директор решил уйти в отставку после скандала.
antonyms: take office, step up, assume power
word_family: step down (verb)
common_mistake: Lavozimdan ketish ma'nosida 'step down from' ishlatiladi, 'step down of' emas.

definition_en: to become less noisy, strong, or active
example_en: We waited for the storm to die down before leaving the house.
example_uz: Uydan chiqishdan oldin bo'ronning tinchishini kutdik.
example_ru: Мы подождали, пока буря утихнет, прежде чем выйти из дома.
word_family: die down (verb)
common_mistake: Ushbu iboraning o'limga aloqasi yo'q; u shovqin, shamol yoki hayajonning pasayishini bildiradi.

definition_en: to choose not to participate in something or to stop belonging to a scheme
example_en: Members can opt out of the new pension scheme if they wish.
example_uz: A'zolar agar xohlasalar, yangi pensiya tizimida qatnashmaslikni tanlashlari mumkin.
example_ru: Участники могут отказаться от участия в новой пенсионной схеме, если пожелают.
word_family: opt out (verb), opt-out (noun)
common_mistake: 'Opt out'dan keyin predlog sifatida 'of' ishlatiladi ('opt out of something'), 'from' emas.

definition_en: to destroy or eliminate something completely
example_en: The disease threatened to wipe out the entire livestock population.
example_uz: Kasallik butun chorva mollarini yo'q qilib yuborish bilan tahdid qildi.
example_ru: Болезнь угрожала полностью уничтожить все поголовье скота.
word_family: wipeout (noun)
common_mistake: Ot shakli 'wipeout' (birga), lekin fe'l iborasi 'wipe out' (alohida yoziladi).

definition_en: to treat or describe something as if it were not important or to avoid discussing it
example_en: The report tried to gloss over the company's financial losses.
example_uz: Hisobotda kompaniyaning moliyaviy yo'qotishlarini ko'rmaganlikka olishga harakat qilindi.
example_ru: В отчете попытались замолчать финансовые потери компании.
word_family: gloss over (verb)
common_mistake: 'Gloss over' asosan kamchilik yoki xatolarni berkitish va yuzaki o'tib ketishda ishlatiladi.

definition_en: to gradually end or fail in a weak or disappointing way
example_en: The protest movement gradually fizzled out due to lack of support.
example_uz: Norozilik harakati qo'llab-quvvatlash yo'qligi sababli sekin-asta so'nib qoldi.
example_ru: Протестное движение постепенно сошло на нет из-за отсутствия поддержки.
word_family: fizzle out (verb)
common_mistake: Bu ibora birdaniga keskin to'xtashni emas, sekin-asta so'nib yo'q bo'lishni anglatadi.

definition_en: to ask a specialist or expert to come and help with a situation
example_en: The company had to call in a consultant to solve the technical problem.
example_uz: Kompaniya texnik muammoni hal qilish uchun konsultant chaqirishga majbur bo'ldi.
example_ru: Компании пришлось вызвать консультанта, чтобы решить техническую проблему.
word_family: call-in (noun)
common_mistake: Do not confuse 'call in' (ask to come) with 'call back' (return a phone call).

definition_en: to make progress or improve in quality or development
example_en: Her English skills are coming along very well this term.
example_uz: Uning ingliz tili ko'nikmalari bu chorakda juda yaxshi rivojlanmoqda.
example_ru: Её навыки английского языка в этой четверти заметно улучшаются.
common_mistake: Avoid using the preposition 'to' after 'come along' when it means 'make progress'.

definition_en: to be mentioned or discussed in a conversation or meeting
example_en: The topic of salary increases came up during yesterday's meeting.
example_uz: Kechagidek majlisda maoshlarni oshirish mavzusi o'rtaga tushdi.
example_ru: Тема повышения зарплаты всплыла во время вчерашнего собрания.
common_mistake: 'Come up' in this sense is intransitive; do not attach a direct object to it.

definition_en: to stop the supply of electricity, water, gas, or telephone service
example_en: The company cut off our electricity because we paid the bill late.
example_uz: Kompaniya hisobni kech to'laganimiz uchun elektr energiyamizni uzib qo'ydi.
example_ru: Компания отключила нам электричество, потому что мы поздно оплатили счет.
word_family: cutoff (noun)
common_mistake: Use 'cut off', not 'cut out', when referring to disconnecting utilities.

definition_en: to fail to keep up with a schedule, work, or payments
example_en: If you miss too many classes, you will quickly fall behind.
example_uz: Agar juda ko'p darslarni qoldirsangiz, tezda orqada qolib ketasiz.
example_ru: Если вы пропустите слишком много занятий, вы быстро отстанете.
common_mistake: Do not use 'back' instead of 'behind'; 'fall back' means to retreat.

definition_en: to succeed in speaking to someone on the telephone
example_en: I tried calling customer service, but I couldn't get through.
example_uz: Men mijozlarga xizmat ko'rsatish bo'limiga qo'ng'iroq qilishga urindim, lekin bog'lana olmadim.
example_ru: Я пытался позвонить в службу поддержки, но не смог дозвониться.
common_mistake: Remember to include 'to' when mentioning the person: 'get through to someone'.

definition_en: to stop employing someone because there is not enough work available
example_en: The factory had to lay off fifty workers due to falling sales.
example_uz: Zavod savdo hajmi kamaygani sababli ellikta ishchini ishdan bo'shatishga majbur bo'ldi.
example_ru: Заводу пришлось уволить пятьдесят рабочих из-за падения продаж.
word_family: layoff (noun)
common_mistake: 'Lay off' implies redundancy for economic reasons, whereas 'fire' usually implies misconduct.

definition_en: to think about something that happened in the past
example_en: When I look back on my school years, I realise how lucky I was.
example_uz: Maktab yillarimga nazar tashlaganimda, qanchalik omadli bo'lganimni tushunaman.
example_ru: Когда я оглядываюсь на свои школьные годы, я понимаю, как мне повезло.
common_mistake: Use the preposition 'on' or 'at' after 'look back', not 'to'.

definition_en: to lose consciousness for a short time
example_en: It was so hot in the room that one student passed out.
example_uz: Xonada issiq juda kuchli bo'lganidan bir talaba hushidan ketdi.
example_ru: В комнате было так жарко, что один студент упал в обморок.
common_mistake: Do not confuse 'pass out' (faint) with 'pass away' (die).

definition_en: to temporarily take the place of someone who is absent
example_en: Another teacher had to stand in for Mr Smith while he was ill.
example_uz: Janob Smit kasal bo'lganida boshqa o'qituvchi uning o'rniga dars o'tishiga to'g'ri keldi.
example_ru: Другому учителю пришлось заменить мистера Смита, пока тот болел.
word_family: stand-in (noun)
common_mistake: Always use 'for' after 'stand in' when identifying the person being replaced.

definition_en: to increase the amount, speed, or intensity of something
example_en: The police have stepped up security around the stadium.
example_uz: Politsiya stadion atrofida xavfsizlik choralarini kuchaytirdi.
example_ru: Полиция усилила меры безопасности вокруг стадиона.
common_mistake: Do not confuse 'step up' (increase) with 'step down' (resign from a post).

definition_en: to admit that something you said was wrong or untrue
example_en: I was wrong to call you lazy, and I take back what I said.
example_uz: Sizni dangasa deb xato qildim va aytgan gaplarimni qaytarib olaman.
example_ru: Я был неправ, назвав вас ленивым, и беру свои слова обратно.
common_mistake: When using a pronoun like 'it', place it between 'take' and 'back' ('take it back').

definition_en: to change or develop into something different
example_en: Our short meeting turned into a three-hour discussion.
example_uz: Qisqa uchrashuvimiz uch soatlik muhokamaga aylanib ketdi.
example_ru: Наша короткая встреча превратилась в трехчасовое обсуждение.
common_mistake: Do not use 'turn in' when you mean 'change into'; 'turn in' means to submit or go to bed.

definition_en: to become thin or damaged through long or frequent use
example_en: Cheap shoes tend to wear out very quickly.
example_uz: Arzon poyabzallar juda tez to'zib ketadi.
example_ru: Дешевая обувь имеет тенденцию очень быстро изнашиваться.
word_family: worn-out (adjective)
common_mistake: Remember the irregular past forms: 'wore out' and 'worn out'.

definition_en: to find yourself in a particular place or situation, usually unexpectedly
example_en: If you carry on driving like that, you will wind up in hospital.
example_uz: Agar bunday haydashda davom etsangiz, kasalxonaga tushib qolasiz.
example_ru: Если вы продолжите так водить, то окажетесь в больнице.
common_mistake: Pronounce the verb as /waɪnd/ (rhyming with 'find'), not /wɪnd/.

definition_en: to improve your knowledge or skill in something that you used to know well
example_en: I need to brush up on my French before traveling to Paris.
example_uz: Parijga borishdan oldin fransuz tilimni takrorlab olishim kerak.
example_ru: Мне нужно освежить в памяти свой французский перед поездкой в Париж.
word_family: brush up (verb)
common_mistake: Oʻrganilayotgan fan yoki til haqida gapirganda 'on' predlogini tushirib qoldirmang.

definition_en: to start to suffer from a minor illness
example_en: I think I am coming down with a cold.
example_uz: Meningcha, men shamollab qolayapman.
example_ru: Кажется, я заболеваю простудой.
word_family: come down (verb)
common_mistake: Ushbu ibora odatda yengilroq kasalliklar (gripp, shamollash) uchun ishlatiladi.

definition_en: to successfully communicate an idea or message to people
example_en: The teacher managed to get her message across to the students.
example_uz: Oʻqituvchi oʻz fikrini oʻquvchilarga tushuntirib bera oldi.
example_ru: Учителю удалось донести свою мысль до учеников.
word_family: get across (verb)
common_mistake: 'Get across' doim tushunilishi kerak bo'lgan g'oya yoki fikr bilan birga keladi.

definition_en: to reduce the amount of something that you eat, drink, or use
example_en: The doctor told him to cut back on sugar.
example_uz: Shifokor unga shakarni kamaytirishni aytdi.
example_ru: Врач посоветовал ему сократить потребление сахара.
word_family: cutback (noun)
common_mistake: Xarajat yoki iste'molni qisqartirishda 'cut back on' birikmasida 'on' predlogi shart.

definition_en: to introduce a new law, system, or rule
example_en: The government plans to bring in new laws to reduce pollution.
example_uz: Hukumat ifloslanishni kamaytirish uchun yangi qonunlarni joriy etishni rejalashtirmoqda.
example_ru: Правительство планирует ввести новые законы для уменьшения загрязнения.
word_family: bring in (verb)
common_mistake: Qonun yoki qoida kiritish haqida gapirganda 'introduce' o'rnida ishlatilishi mumkin.

definition_en: to completely understand and remember something you hear or read
example_en: There was so much information that I couldn't take it all in.
example_uz: Ma'lumot shunchalik ko'p ediki, hammasini tushunib yetolmadim.
example_ru: Было так много информации, что я не мог всё это усвоить.
word_family: intake (noun)
common_mistake: Sifatida qo'llanganda ('be taken in') 'aldanib qolmoq' ma'nosini ham beradi.

definition_en: to recover from a serious illness or succeed in a difficult situation
example_en: Everyone was relieved when the patient pulled through after the surgery.
example_uz: Operatsiyadan so'ng bemor tuzalib ketganida hamma yengil tortdi.
example_ru: Все почувствовали облегчение, когда пациент пошел на поправку после операции.
word_family: pull through (verb)
common_mistake: Odatda og'ir kasallik yoki inqirozdan omon qolishda ishlatiladi.

definition_en: to continue to support someone, especially in a difficult situation
example_en: She promised to stand by her brother no matter what happened.
example_uz: U nima bo'lishidan qat'i nazar, ukasini qo'llab-quvvatlashga va'da berdi.
example_ru: Она обещала поддерживать своего брата, что бы ни случилось.
word_family: standby (noun)
common_mistake: Biror kishini qo'llab-quvvatlash ma'nosida 'stand by someone' iborasida 'by' predlogini tushirmang.

definition_en: to intentionally destroy a building or structure
example_en: They plan to tear down the old factory and build apartments.
example_uz: Ular eski zavodni buzib tashlab, xonadonlar qurishni rejalashtirishmoqda.
example_ru: Они планируют снести старую фабрику и построить жилые дома.
word_family: tear down (verb)
common_mistake: Ko'pincha binolarga nisbatan qo'llaniladi, kichik buyumlar uchun emas.

definition_en: to publicly demand that something should happen
example_en: The protest leaders called for an immediate ceasefire.
example_uz: E'tiroz yetakchilari zudlik bilan o't ochishni to'xtatishni talab qilishdi.
example_ru: Лидеры протеста призвали к немедленному прекращению огня.
word_family: call for (verb)
common_mistake: 'Call for' rasmiy chaqiriq yoki talab bildirishda ishlatiladi.

definition_en: to delay someone or something
example_en: Sorry I'm late; I was held up in heavy traffic.
example_uz: Kechikkanim uchun uzr, tirbandlikda ushlanib qoldim.
example_ru: Извините за опоздание, меня задержали сильные пробки.
word_family: holdup (noun)
common_mistake: Kechikib qolish ma'nosida ko'pincha majhul nisbatda (be held up) qo'llaniladi.

definition_en: to force a way through something that is holding you back
example_en: The sun finally broke through the thick clouds.
example_uz: Quyosh nihoyat qalin bulutlar orasidan yorib chiqdi.
example_ru: Солнце наконец пробилось сквозь густые облака.
word_family: breakthrough (noun)
common_mistake: Fe'l shakli alohida ('break through'), ot shakli esa birga yoziladi ('breakthrough').

definition_en: to be patient with someone while they complete a task or solve a problem
example_en: Please bear with me for a minute while I locate your file.
example_uz: Faylingizni topgunimcha, iltimos, bir daqiqa sabr qiling.
example_ru: Пожалуйста, подождите минуту, пока я найду ваш файл.
word_family: bear, bearing
common_mistake: 'Bare with me' deb yozish xatodir; 'bear' fe'lidan foydalanilishi kerak.

definition_en: to reach the lowest point in a process or period of decline before stabilizing or improving
example_en: Economists believe that housing prices have finally bottomed out.
example_uz: Iqtisodchilarning fikricha, uy-joy narxlari nihoyat eng quyi nuqtasiga yetdi.
example_ru: Экономисты считают, что цены на жилье наконец прекратили падение.
synonyms: level off, reach rock bottom, stabilize
word_family: bottom, bottoming out
common_mistake: O'zbek tiliga 'tubiga cho'kish' deb so'zma-so'z tarjima qilish noto'g'ri, bu pasayish to'xtab barqarorlashuvni anglatadi.

definition_en: to start suddenly and strongly, especially something unpleasant like a war, fire, or disease
example_en: A fierce argument broke out during the board meeting.
example_uz: Kengash majlisida qizg'in tortishuv to'satdan avj oldi.
example_ru: Во время заседания совета директоров внезапно вспыхнул бурный спор.
word_family: outbreak, break
common_mistake: 'Break out' iborasini faqat qamoqdan qochish ma'nosida ishlatish cheklovdir; u yong'in va urushlarga nisbatan ham keng qo'llanadi.

translation_uz: vaziyatdan moddiy foyda ko'rmoq, imkoniyatni pulga aylantirmoq
translation_ru: нажиться на, воспользоваться в своих интересах
definition_en: to take advantage of a situation or trend in order to gain a financial or personal benefit
example_en: Many small companies are trying to cash in on the popularity of AI.
example_uz: Ko'pgina kichik kompaniyalar sun'iy intellekt mashhurligidan foyda ko'rishga harakat qilmoqda.
example_ru: Многие небольшие компании пытаются нажиться на популярности искусственного интеллекта.
antonyms: miss out on, lose out on
word_family: cash, cashing in
common_mistake: Ko'pincha predlogsiz 'cash on' deb ishlatiladi, ammo to'g'ri shakli 'cash in on'dir.

definition_en: to rely on or trust someone or something to provide help or support
example_en: You can always count on Sarah to give honest advice.
example_uz: To'g'ri maslahat olishda har doim Saraga suyanishingiz mumkin.
example_ru: Вы всегда можете рассчитывать на то, что Сара даст честный совет.
word_family: count, dependable
common_mistake: 'Count on' iborasidan keyin 'on' predlogi tushirib qoldirilmaydi; 'count me' emas, 'count on me' bo'lishi kerak.

definition_en: to draw a line through a word or text to show that it is incorrect or no longer needed
example_en: Please cross out any spelling mistakes you find in the essay.
example_uz: Inshoda uchratgan har qanday imlo xatolarining ustidan chizib qo'ying.
example_ru: Пожалуйста, вычеркните все орфографические ошибки, которые найдете в эссе.
word_family: cross, crossing out
common_mistake: 'Cross out' va 'erase' fe'llarini aralashtirmang; 'erase' rezinada o'chirish bo'lsa, 'cross out' chiziq tortib o'chirishdir.

definition_en: to prepare and write a formal document such as a contract, plan, or list
example_en: The lawyer will draw up the agreement by tomorrow afternoon.
example_uz: Yurist ertaga tushgacha shartnomani tuzib beradi.
example_ru: Юрист составит соглашение к завтрашнему дню.
word_family: draw, draft, drawing up
common_mistake: 'Draw' rasmiy hujjatlar bilan kelganda 'rasm chizmoq' emas, 'tuzmoq' ma'nosini bildiradi.

definition_en: to gradually become less friendly or lose contact with someone over time
example_en: After leaving university, the two friends slowly drifted apart.
example_uz: Universitetni tugatgach, ikki do'st sekin-asta bir-biridan uzoqlashib ketishdi.
example_ru: После окончания университета двое друзей постепенно отдалились друг от друга.
word_family: drift, drifting
common_mistake: Urush-janjal sababli munosabat uzilishida emas, balki vaqt o'tib sekin-asta uzoqlashishda ishlatiladi.

translation_uz: achchiq haqiqatni tan olmoq va unga tik qaramoq
definition_en: to accept and attempt to deal with a difficult situation or uncomfortable truth
example_en: He needs to face up to the fact that he cannot afford this lifestyle.
example_uz: U ushbu turmush tarziga qurbi yetmasligi haqidagi haqiqatga tik qarashi kerak.
example_ru: Ему нужно смириться с тем фактом, что он не может позволить себе такой образ жизни.
word_family: face, facing
common_mistake: Predloglarni tushirib 'face to' deyish noto'g'ri; to'liq 'face up to' shakli ishlatilishi zarur.

translation_uz: vaqt ajratib, nihoyat biror ishni qilmoq
translation_ru: добраться до, наконец найти время для
definition_en: to finally find enough time or energy to do something that has been planned for a long time
example_en: I finally got round to fixing the leaking tap in the kitchen.
example_uz: Nihoyat oshxonadagi tomayotgan jo'mrakni tuzatishga vaqt topdim.
example_ru: Я наконец добрался до ремонта протекающего крана на кухне.
word_family: get, round
common_mistake: 'Get round to' iborasidan keyin keladigan fe'lga '-ing' qo'shiladi (masalan: get round to fixing).

definition_en: to make a serious mistake or spoil something by doing it badly
example_en: I prepared well for the interview, so I hope I do not mess up.
example_uz: Suhbatga yaxshi tayyorlandim, shuning uchun rasvosini chiqarmayman deb umid qilaman.
example_ru: Я хорошо подготовился к собеседованию, поэтому надеюсь, что не накосячу.
word_family: mess, messy, messed up
common_mistake: Bu so'zlashuv uslubiga oid ibora; rasmiy akademik insholarda uning o'rniga 'make a mistake' ishlatilgani ma'qul.

definition_en: to carefully consider and compare the pros and cons of a situation before making a decision
example_en: We need to weigh up the pros and cons before buying the house.
example_uz: Uyni sotib olishdan oldin barcha ijobiy va salbiy tomonlarni atroflicha o'ylab ko'rishimiz kerak.
example_ru: Нам нужно взвесить все за и против перед покупкой дома.
word_family: weigh, weight, weighing
common_mistake: 'Weigh' fe'li jismoniy vaznni o'lchash bo'lsa, 'weigh up' qaror qabul qilishda ijobiy va salbiy tomonlarni solishtirishdir.

translation_uz: urishib qolmoq, yuz ko'rmas bo'lib ketmoq
definition_en: to have an argument with someone and stop being friendly with them
example_en: They fell out over a misunderstanding about money and haven't spoken since.
example_uz: Ular pul borasidagi tushunmovchilik sababli urishib qolishdi va o'shandan beri gaplashishmayapti.
example_ru: Они поссорились из-за недоразумения с деньгами и с тех пор не разговаривают.
word_family: fallout
common_mistake: Biror kishi bilan urishmoq demoqchi bo'lganda 'fall out'dan keyin 'with' predlogi ishlatiladi, masalan: 'fall out with someone'.

definition_en: to visit a place and look at the things in it
example_en: We had an hour to look round the city center before our train arrived.
example_uz: Poyezdimiz kelguniga qadar shahar markazini aylanib ko'rishga bir soat vaqtimiz bor edi.
example_ru: У нас был час, чтобы осмотреть центр города до прибытия поезда.
word_family: look
common_mistake: 'Look round' va 'look around' bir xil ma'noni anglatadi, lekin Britaniya ingliz tilida 'look round' ko'proq ishlatiladi.

definition_en: to start liking someone or something, or start doing something as a habit
example_en: The new students took to the teaching style immediately.
example_uz: Yangi talabalar o'qitish usulini darhol yoqtirib qolishdi.
example_ru: Новые студенты сразу прониклись симпатией к стилю преподавания.
synonyms: warm to, like, get fond of
word_family: take
common_mistake: 'Take to' iborasidan keyin fe'l kelsa, u -ing shaklida bo'lishi kerak, masalan: 'took to swimming'.

definition_en: to refuse to allow someone to enter a place
example_en: Dozens of fans were turned away because the concert was completely sold out.
example_uz: Konsert chiptalari to'liq sotilib ketgani sababli o'nlab ishqibozlar qaytarib yuborildi.
example_ru: Десятки поклонников не впустили, потому что все билеты на концерт были распроданы.
word_family: turn
common_mistake: 'Turn away' iborasi odamlarni kirgizmaslik ma'nosida majhul nisbatda (passive voice) juda ko'p ishlatiladi: 'were turned away'.

definition_en: to become extremely tired and ill because of working too hard over a long period
example_en: If she continues working eighty hours a week, she will burn out soon.
example_uz: Agar u haftasiga sakson soatdan ishlashda davom etsa, tez orada ishdan toliqib qoladi.
example_ru: Если она продолжит работать по восемьдесят часов в неделю, то скоро выгорит.
word_family: burnout
common_mistake: Ot shakli 'burnout' bitta so'z bo'lib yoziladi, lekin fe'li 'burn out' tarzida ajratib yoziladi.

definition_en: to formally ask someone to do something, or to ask someone in a class to answer
example_en: The teacher called on Sarah to answer the first question.
example_uz: O'qituvchi birinchi savolga javob berish uchun Sarahga so'z berdi.
example_ru: Учитель вызвал Сару, чтобы она ответила на первый вопрос.
word_family: call
common_mistake: 'Call on' darsda o'quvchiga so'z berish yoki rasman murojaat qilishda ishlatiladi, 'call up' esa telefon qilish degan ma'noni beradi.

definition_en: to encourage someone by shouting praises or words of enthusiasm
example_en: Thousands of spectators gathered to cheer on the marathon runners.
example_uz: Marafon yuguruvchilarini qo'llab-quvvatlash uchun minglab tomoshabinlar yig'ildi.
example_ru: Тысячи зрителей собрались, чтобы поддержать марафонцев.
word_family: cheer
common_mistake: Kishilik olmoshlari bilan ishlatilganda olmosh o'rtada kelishi kerak: 'cheer them on' ('cheer on them' emas).

definition_en: to happen successfully as planned
example_en: The surprise party came off without any problems.
example_uz: Kutilmagan ziyofat hech qanday muammosiz juda muvaffaqiyatli o'tdi.
example_ru: Вечеринка-сюрприз прошла успешно и без каких-либо проблем.
word_family: come
common_mistake: 'Come off' reja yoki tadbirlarning muvaffaqiyatli o'tishini bildiradi; 'come out' esa mahsulot yoki natijaning e'lon qilinishiga nisbatan ishlatiladi.

definition_en: if something dawns on you, you realize or understand it for the first time
example_en: It suddenly dawned on him that he had left his keys inside the car.
example_uz: Kalitlarini mashina ichida qoldirgani to'satdan uning xayoliga keldi.
example_ru: Его внезапно осенило, что он оставил ключи внутри машины.
word_family: dawn
common_mistake: Ushbu ibora odatda 'it dawns on someone that...' strukturasida 'it' olmoshi bilan ishlatiladi.

definition_en: to pay a brief, usually informal visit to someone
example_en: Feel free to drop in whenever you are in the neighborhood.
example_uz: Shu atroflarda bo'lganingizda xohlagan vaqtingizda kirib o'ting.
example_ru: Заглядывайте в любое время, когда будете поблизости.
synonyms: call round, drop by, pop in
word_family: drop-in
common_mistake: Biror kishining uyiga kirib o'tmoqchi bo'lsangiz, 'drop in on someone' birikmasi ishlatiladi.

definition_en: to move in the direction of a particular place or situation
example_en: After finishing work, they headed for the nearest restaurant.
example_uz: Ishni tugatgach, ular eng yaqin restoran tomonga yo'l olishdi.
example_ru: Закончив работу, они направились в ближайший ресторан.
synonyms: make for, aim for, set off towards
word_family: head
common_mistake: 'Head for' nafaqat joy tomonga, balki nomaqbul oqibat tomonga borishni ham bildirishi mumkin (masalan: 'heading for disaster').

definition_en: to examine or inspect something quickly
example_en: Could you look over my essay and check for any spelling errors?
example_uz: Inshoimni ko'zdan kechirib, imlo xatolarini tekshirib bera olasizmi?
example_ru: Не могли бы вы просмотреть мое эссе и проверить на наличие орфографических ошибок?
word_family: look
common_mistake: 'Look over' chala va tez ko'rib chiqishni anglatadi; diqqat bilan o'rganish uchun 'study' yoki 'examine thoroughly' ishlatiladi.

translation_ru: выручать из беды, спасать от банкротства
definition_en: To rescue someone or an organisation from a difficult, especially financial, situation.
example_en: The government had to bail out the failing bank to prevent a financial crisis.
example_uz: Moliya inqirozining oldini olish uchun hukumat kasodga uchrayotgan bankni qutqarib qolishiga toʻgʻri keldi.
example_ru: Правительству пришлось спасать терпящий крах банк, чтобы предотвратить финансовый кризис.
word_family: bailout
common_mistake: 'Bail out' iborasini samolyotdan parashyutda sakrash tushunchasiga aralashtirmang; ko'proq moliyaviy qutqaruv ma'nosida ishlatiladi.

definition_en: To look or seem similar to the surrounding people or things, so as not to be easily noticed.
example_en: The chameleon changes its skin color to blend in with its surroundings.
example_uz: Xameleon atrof-muhit bilan birikib ketish uchun terisining rangini oʻzgartiradi.
example_ru: Хамелеон меняет цвет кожи, чтобы слиться с окружающей средой.
word_family: blend
common_mistake: 'Blend in' shunchaki aralashtirish emas, balki atrofga moslashib bildirmaslikni anglatadi.

definition_en: To meet someone unexpectedly or by chance.
example_en: I bumped into an old school friend at the supermarket yesterday.
example_uz: Kecha supermarketda tasodifan eski maktabdosh doʻstimni uchratib qoldim.
example_ru: Вчера в супермаркете я случайно встретил старого школьного друга.
synonyms: run into, come across, meet by chance
word_family: bump
common_mistake: 'Bump into' faqat to'qnashib ketish emas, kutilmaganda ko'rishib qolishni ham bildiradi.

definition_en: To investigate or try to discover what someone is doing, especially to ensure they are safe or doing their work.
example_en: My parents call every evening to check up on me while I am at university.
example_uz: Men universitetda oʻqiyotganimda ota-onam har kuni kechqurun holimdan xabar olish uchun qoʻngʻiroq qilishadi.
example_ru: Мои родители звонят каждый вечер, чтобы узнать, как у меня дела, пока я учусь в университете.
synonyms: monitor, inspect, keep an eye on
word_family: check-up
common_mistake: 'Check up on' iborasida har uchala so'z ketma-ket ishlatilishi shart.

translation_uz: mahkam yopishib olmoq, saqlab qolishga urinmoq
definition_en: To refuse to stop believing, hoping, or relying on something.
example_en: Despite the difficulties, she continued to cling to the hope of a better future.
example_uz: Qiyinchiliklarga qaramay, u yaxshiroq kelajakka boʻlgan umidini saqlab qolishga urindi.
example_ru: Несмотря на трудности, она продолжала цепляться за надежду на лучшее будущее.
synonyms: hold on to, stick to, retain
word_family: clingy
common_mistake: 'Cling' fe'lidan so'ng 'on' emas, 'to' predlogi ishlatiladi.

definition_en: To become less common and eventually disappear completely.
example_en: Many ancient traditions are slowly dying out in modern society.
example_uz: Zamonaviy jamiyatda koʻplab qadimiy anʼanalar sekin-asta yoʻqolib bormoqda.
example_ru: Многие древние традиции постепенно вымирают в современном обществе.
word_family: die, death
common_mistake: 'Die out' alohida shaxsning vafot etishiga nisbatan ishlatilmaydi; u tur, an'ana yoki turlarga taalluqli.

definition_en: To stop using, doing, or having something; to abolish.
example_en: The company decided to do away with paper invoices to save money.
example_uz: Kompaniya pulni tejash uchun qogʻoz hisob-fakturalardan voz kechishga qaror qildi.
example_ru: Компания решила отказаться от бумажных счетов, чтобы сэкономить деньги.
word_family: do
common_mistake: 'Do away with' birikmasida 'with' tushirib qoldirilmaydi.

definition_en: To decrease and stop being available, or to completely dry.
example_en: Funding for the research project dried up after two years.
example_uz: Tadqiqot loyihasini moliyalashtirish ikki yildan soʻng tugab qoldi.
example_ru: Финансирование исследовательского проекта иссякло через два года.
word_family: dryness, dry
common_mistake: 'Dry up' faqat suvga nisbatan emas, balki mablag' va manbalarning tugashiga nisbatan ham ishlatiladi.

translation_uz: yangi va muhim ishga kirishmoq, boshlamoq
definition_en: To start or engage in a new, important, or demanding project or journey.
example_en: After graduating from university, she decided to embark on a career in journalism.
example_uz: Universitetni tugatgach, u jurnalistika sohasida faoliyat boshlashga qaror qildi.
example_ru: После окончания университета она решила начать карьеру в журналистике.
synonyms: commence, launch into, set out on
word_family: embarkation
common_mistake: 'Embark on' birikmasidan so'ng ot yoki fe'lning '-ing' shakli keladi, fe me'yoriy shakli emas.

definition_en: To defend oneself against an attack, criticism, or unwanted questions.
example_en: The politician had to fend off difficult questions from journalists during the interview.
example_uz: Siyosatchi intervyu davomida jurnalistlarning qiyin savollarini daf qilishiga toʻgʻri keldi.
example_ru: Политику пришлось отбиваться от сложных вопросов журналистов во время интервью.
word_family: fend
common_mistake: 'Fend off' iborasini 'fend for' (o'zini o'zi ta'minlamoq) bilan adashtirmang.

definition_en: To prepare for an activity or event that is going to happen.
example_en: The team is gearing up for the final match of the tournament.
example_uz: Jamoa turnirning final oʻyiniga tayyorgarlik koʻrmoqda.
example_ru: Команда готовится к финальному матчу турнира.
word_family: gear
common_mistake: 'Gear up' odatda 'for' predlogi bilan ishlatiladi (gear up for something).

definition_en: To move, develop, or respond more slowly than others.
example_en: The country is lagging behind in the adoption of renewable energy technologies.
example_uz: Mamlakat qayta tiklanadigan energiya texnologiyalarini joriy etishda orqada qolmoqda.
example_ru: Страна отстает в внедрении технологий возобновляемой энергетики.
synonyms: fall behind, trail, keep pace poorly
word_family: laggard, lag
common_mistake: 'Lag behind' sur'at sekinligi tufayli orqada qolishni bildiradi, 'lag' fe'li yolg'iz o'zi kamdan-kam qo'llanadi.

definition_en: to become popular or fashionable, or to understand something after a short time
example_en: The new mobile application quickly caught on among university students.
example_uz: Yangi mobil ilova universitet talabalari orasida tezda ommalashdi.
example_ru: Новое мобильное приложение быстро вошло в моду среди студентов университета.
word_family: catchy
common_mistake: 'Catch on to' biror narsani tushunib yetish ma'nosida ishlatilganda 'to' predlogi tushirib qoldirilmasligi kerak.

definition_en: to rely on or expect something to happen
example_en: We cannot bank on good weather for the outdoor concert tomorrow.
example_uz: Ertangi ochiq havodagi konsert uchun yaxshi ob-havoga ishonib qololmaymiz.
example_ru: Мы не можем рассчитывать на хорошую погоду для завтрашнего концерта на открытом воздухе.
word_family: bankable
common_mistake: 'Bank on' iborasida 'on' o'rniga 'in' yoki 'to' predloglarini ishlatish xatodir.

definition_en: to be caused by or develop as a result of something
example_en: Most of his current health issues stem from a lack of physical exercise.
example_uz: Uning hozirgi salomatlik muammolarining ko'pi jismoniy mashqlar yetishmasligidan kelib chiqqan.
example_ru: Большинство его нынешних проблем со здоровьем проистекают из-за недостатка физических упражнений.
synonyms: originate from, arise from, derive from
word_family: stemmed
common_mistake: 'Stem from' birikmasidan so'ng fe'l kelsa, unga '-ing' qo'shimchasi qo'shilishi kerak.

definition_en: to leave a school, college, or course before finishing it
example_en: He decided to drop out of university to start his own technology company.
example_uz: U o'zining texnologiya kompaniyasini boshlash uchun universitetni tashlab ketishga qaror qildi.
example_ru: Он решил бросить университет, чтобы основать собственную технологическую компанию.
word_family: dropout
common_mistake: 'Drop out of' birikmasida o'quv yurti nomi berilganda 'of' predlogi tushirib qoldirilmaydi.

definition_en: to do something wrong or illegal without being punished or criticized
example_en: You cannot expect to cheat in the exam and get away with it.
example_uz: Imtihonda g'irromlik qilib, jazosiz qolaman deb o'ylamang.
example_ru: Не надейтесь списать на экзамене и остаться безнаказанным.
common_mistake: 'Get away with'dan so'ng fe'l kelsa, u fe'l gerundiy (-ing) shaklida bo'lishi shart.

definition_en: to become fine after rain, or to solve a problem or misunderstanding
example_en: We can go for a walk once the rain clears up.
example_uz: Yomg'ir yog'ishi to'xtab, havo ochilib ketsa, aylanishga chiqishimiz mumkin.
example_ru: Мы сможем пойти на прогулку, как только дождь прекратится и прояснится.
word_family: clear, clearance
common_mistake: 'Clear up' ob-havo ochiqlashishi ma'nosida majhul nisbatda (passive voice) ishlatilmaydi.

definition_en: to consider something carefully before making a final decision
example_en: I need a few days to think over your job offer before giving an answer.
example_uz: Javob berishdan oldin ish taklifingizni bir necha kun chuqur o'ylab ko'rishim kerak.
example_ru: Мне нужно несколько дней, чтобы обдумать ваше предложение о работе, прежде чем дать ответ.
word_family: thoughtful
common_mistake: Olmoshlar (it, them) ishlatilganda, ular 'think' va 'over' o'rtasida kelishi kerak: 'think it over'.

definition_en: to persuade someone to do something
example_en: Her friends managed to talk her into going to the party.
example_uz: Do'stlari uni ziyofatga borishga ko'ndirishga muvaffaq bo'lishdi.
example_ru: Её друзьям удалось уговорить её пойти на вечеринку.
common_mistake: 'Talk into' birikmasidan so'ng keladigan fe'l '-ing' shaklida bo'lishi shart ('talk into doing').

definition_en: to contribute money or help toward a shared goal or purchase
example_en: If everyone chips in ten dollars, we can buy a nice present for the teacher.
example_uz: Agar har kim o'n dollardan pul tashlasa, o'qituvchiga yaxshi sovg'a sotib olishimiz mumkin.
example_ru: Если каждый скинется по десять долларов, мы сможем купить хороший подарок учителю.
common_mistake: 'Chip in' pul yig'ish jarayonida ko'pincha predlogsiz yoki 'with' bilan ishlatiladi; 'chip to' deb ishlatish xatodir.

definition_en: to begin and seem likely to continue, especially regarding bad weather or winter
example_en: The winter cold set in early this year, bringing heavy snow.
example_uz: Bu yil qishki sovuq erta boshlanib, qalin qor olib keldi.
example_ru: В этом году зимние холода начались рано, принеся с собой сильный снег.
common_mistake: 'Set in' odatda ob-havo, kasallik yoki yoqimsiz holatlarga nisbatan qo'llaniladi.

definition_en: to admit that you were wrong or to stop demanding something during an argument
example_en: Neither side was willing to back down during the negotiations.
example_uz: Muzokaralar davomida hech bir tomon yon berishni xohlamadi.
example_ru: Ни одна из сторон не была готова уступить во время переговоров.
common_mistake: 'Back down' fe'lidan so'ng to'ldiruvchi to'g'ridan-to'g me'yorda kelmaydi; u o'zliksiz hosil bo'ladi.

definition_en: to prepare for physical activity by exercising gently first
example_en: It is important to warm up before running to avoid injuries.
example_uz: Jarohatlarning oldini olish uchun yugurishdan oldin chig'ilyozdi qilish muhimdir.
example_ru: Важно размяться перед бегом, чтобы избежать травм.
word_family: warm-up
common_mistake: 'Warm up' mashqdan oldingi qizdirishga, 'cool down' esa mashqdan keyingi mashqlarga nisbatan ishlatiladi.

definition_en: to accept or obey a rule, law, agreement, or decision
example_en: All players must abide by the rules of the tournament.
example_uz: Barcha oʻyinchilar turnir qoidalariga rioya qilishlari shart.
example_ru: Все игроки должны соблюдать правила турнира.
word_family: abiding
common_mistake: 'Abide with' deb ishlatish xatodir; qoidalar yoki qarorlarga rioya qilish uchun 'abide by' iborasi qoʻllaniladi.

definition_en: to explain the reason for something or form a specified amount or proportion of something
example_en: E-books account for roughly thirty percent of total book sales.
example_uz: Elektron kitoblar jami kitob sotuvining taxminan oʻttiz foizini tashkil qiladi.
example_ru: Электронные книги составляют примерно тридцать процентов от общих продаж книг.
word_family: account, accountable
common_mistake: 'Account to' bilan adashtirmang; miqdor yoki sababni koʻrsatishda 'account for' ishlatiladi.

definition_en: to ask several people for information or help regarding something
example_en: I asked around, but nobody knew where the old station was.
example_uz: Men atrofdagilardan surishtirdim, lekin hech kim eski vokzal qayerdaligini bilmas edi.
example_ru: Я расспросил людей вокруг, но никто не знал, где находится старый вокзал.
common_mistake: 'Ask around somebody' deyish xatodir; iboradan soʻng toʻldiruvchi (obyekt) ishlatilmaydi.

definition_en: to change the date or time of an event so that it happens earlier than expected
example_en: The meeting has been brought forward to ten o'clock tomorrow morning.
example_uz: Uchrashuv ertaga ertalab soat oʻnga koʻchirildi.
example_ru: Встречу перенесли на десять часов утра завтрашнего дня.
common_mistake: Ushbu iborani voqeani keyinroqqa surish ma'nosida ishlatmang, u vaqtni ertaroqqa koʻchirishni bildiradi.

definition_en: to increase, strengthen, or accumulate something over time
example_en: She took evening classes to build up her confidence in speaking English.
example_uz: U ingliz tilida gapirishdagi ishonchini oshirish uchun kechki kurslarga qatnashdi.
example_ru: Она ходила на вечерние курсы, чтобы укреплять уверенность в английской речи.
word_family: buildup
common_mistake: Ot shakli 'buildup' birga yoziladi, lekin fe'l birikmasi 'build up' koʻrinishida ajratib yoziladi.

definition_en: to make a brief, informal visit to a person or place while going somewhere else
example_en: I will call by on my way home from work to deliver the files.
example_uz: Ishdan uyga qaytayotib, hujjatlarni berish uchun yoʻl-yoʻlakay kirib oʻtaman.
example_ru: Я загляну по дороге домой с работы, чтобы передать документы.
synonyms: drop by, pop in, call in
common_mistake: 'Call by' rasmiy tashrif emas, balki qisqa va yoʻl-yoʻlakay boʻlgan uchrashuvlarga nisbatan qoʻllaniladi.

translation_uz: kutilmaganda qiyin ahvolga solmoq, xatosini tutib olmoq
definition_en: to place someone in an unexpected, difficult situation or to discover that they made a mistake
example_en: The sudden change in the weather caught us out without umbrellas.
example_uz: Ob-havoning toʻsatdan oʻzgarishi bizni soyabonsiz kutilmagan qiyin ahvolga solib qoʻydi.
example_ru: Внезапная перемена погоды застала нас врасплох без зонтов.
common_mistake: Majhul nisbatda tez-tez 'be caught out' shaklida ishlatiladi, soʻzma-soʻz 'ushlab olmoq' deb tarjima qilmang.

definition_en: to stop operating or doing business permanently or for a lengthy period
example_en: The local bakery had to close down due to rising fuel costs.
example_uz: Mahalliy novvoyxona yoqilgʻi narxi oshgani sababli yopilishiga toʻgʻri keldi.
example_ru: Местной пекарне пришлось закрыться из-за роста цен на топливо.
word_family: closedown
common_mistake: Eshik yoki derazani yopish bilan adashtirmang; 'close down' korxona yoki biznesning faoliyatini toʻxtatishiga aytiladi.

definition_en: to receive or be subjected to something unpleasant, especially criticism or blame
example_en: The government's new policy came in for severe criticism from the public.
example_uz: Hukumatning yangi siyosati jamoatchilik tomonidan keskin tanqidga duchor boʻldi.
example_ru: Новая политика правительства подверглась суровой критике со стороны общественности.
common_mistake: 'Come in for' iborasidan keyin 'criticism' yoki 'blame' kabi otlar keladi; kelóshiklarni (prepositions) tushirib qoldirmang.

definition_en: to repair and decorate a building or vehicle, or to fasten a piece of clothing
example_en: They bought an old cottage in the countryside and spent months doing it up.
example_uz: Ular qishloqdagi eski kottejni sotib olishdi va uni ta'mirlashga oylar sarflashdi.
example_ru: Они купили старый коттедж в деревне и потратили месяцы на его ремонт.
common_mistake: Kiyim tugmasini taqishda va bino ta'mirlashda ishlatiladi, lekin oddiy 'ta'mirlamoq' (repair) oʻrnida har doim ham toʻgʻri kelavermaydi.

definition_en: to use information, experience, knowledge, or resources to help achieve something
example_en: In her essay, she drew on her personal experiences as a teacher.
example_uz: U oʻz inshosida oʻqituvchilik shaxsiy tajribasiga tayandi.
example_ru: В своем эссе она опиралась на личный опыт работы учителем.
common_mistake: Rasm chizish ('draw') bilan adashtirmang; ibora sifatida 'manbaga tayanmoq' yoki 'foydalanmoq' degani.

definition_en: to become less intense, severe, or forceful
example_en: As the heavy rain began to ease off, we decided to continue our journey.
example_uz: Kuchli yomgʻir susaya boshlagach, biz yoʻlimizni davom ettirishga qaror qildik.
example_ru: Когда сильный дождь начал ослабевать, мы решили продолжить путь.
word_family: ease
common_mistake: Ob-havo, ogʻriq yoki bosim pasayishi uchun 'ease off' birikmasi qoʻllaniladi.

definition_en: to support or confirm a statement, theory, or belief
example_en: The results of the second experiment bear out our original hypothesis.
example_uz: Ikkinchi tajriba natijalari bizning dastlabki gipotezamizni tasdiqlaydi.
example_ru: Результаты второго эксперимента подтверждают нашу первоначальную гипотезу.
word_family: bear out, borne out
common_mistake: Ushbu iborada 'bear' fe'lining o'tgan zamon shakli 'bore out' va sifatdosh shakli 'borne out' ekanligini unutmaslik kerak.

translation_uz: ishga jiddiy kirishmoq, g'ayrat bilan kirishmoq
translation_ru: серьезно взяться за работу, усердно работать
definition_en: to start working hard and seriously on something
example_en: If you want to pass the exam, you need to buckle down and study every evening.
example_uz: Agar imtihondan o'tmoqchi bo'lsangiz, jiddiy kirishib, har kuni kechqurun shug'ullanishingiz kerak.
example_ru: Если вы хотите сдать экзамен, вам нужно серьезно взяться за учебу и заниматься каждый вечер.
word_family: buckle down
common_mistake: 'Buckle' so'zidan keyin har doim 'down' ko'makchisi keladi; 'buckle up' esa xavfsizlik kamarini taqishni anglatadi.

definition_en: to take strict or urgent action to stop or limit an illegal or unwanted activity
example_en: The government plans to clamp down on tax evasion this year.
example_uz: Hukumat bu yil soliq to'lashdan bo'yin tovlashga qarshi qat'iy choralar ko'rishni rejalashtirmoqda.
example_ru: В этом году правительство планирует принять строгие меры против уклонения от уплаты налогов.
word_family: clamp down, clampdown
common_mistake: Ushbu iborada obyekt oldidan 'on' predlogi ishlatilishi shart.

definition_en: to try to say or imply something, usually used in continuous forms
example_en: I do not quite understand what you are driving at.
example_uz: Men nimani nazarda tutayotganingizni unchalik tushunmayapman.
example_ru: Я не совсем понимаю, к чему вы клоните.
word_family: driving at
common_mistake: Odatda davomli zamonlarda (Continuous) 'What are you driving at?' shaklida qo'llaniladi.

definition_en: to disapprove of something or view it with displeasure
example_en: Using personal phones during working hours is frowned upon in this office.
example_uz: Ushbu idorada ish vaqtida shaxsiy telefonlardan foydalanish ma'qullanmaydi.
example_ru: В этом офисе не одобряется использование личных телефонов в рабочее время.
word_family: frown upon, frown on
common_mistake: Odatda majhul nisbatda (Passive Voice) 'is frowned upon' ko'rinishida ko'proq ishlatiladi.

translation_ru: кое-как справиться, довести дело до конца
definition_en: to succeed in doing something or dealing with a situation despite a lack of organization or preparation
example_en: Although we did not have a clear plan, we managed to muddle through the crisis.
example_uz: Aniq rejamiz bo'lmasada, inqirozni bir ilojini qilib epalab o'tdik.
example_ru: Хотя у нас не было четкого плана, нам удалось кое-как справиться с кризисом.
word_family: muddle through
common_mistake: Ushbu ibora puxta reja emas, balki tavakkal yoki vaziyatga qarab ish tutishni anglatadi.

definition_en: to try to make something seem less important, serious, or harmful than it really is
example_en: The company tried to play down the serious extent of the financial losses.
example_uz: Kompaniya moliyaviy yo'qotishlarning jiddiy darajasini kamaytirib ko'rsatishga urindi.
example_ru: Компания пыталась преуменьшить степень серьезности финансовых потерь.
word_family: play down
common_mistake: 'Play down' va 'downplay' sinonimlar bo'lib, 'play down' fe'li bo'laklarga ajralishi mumkin (masalan, play the issue down).

definition_en: to choose one person or thing from a group for special attention, praise, or criticism
example_en: It is unfair to single out one employee for a mistake made by the entire team.
example_uz: Butun jamoa yo'l qo'ygan xato uchun birgina xodimni ajratib ko'rsatish nohaqlikdir.
example_ru: Несправедливо выделять одного сотрудника за ошибку, допущенную всей командой.
word_family: single out
common_mistake: 'Single out' biror kishini ham maqtov, ham tanqid uchun boshqalardan ajratishda ishlatilishi mumkin.

definition_en: to examine or assess a person or situation in order to form a judgment
example_en: The experienced manager quickly sized up the candidate during the interview.
example_uz: Tajribali menejer suhbat davomida nomzodni tezda baholab oldi.
example_ru: Опытный менеджер быстро оценил кандидата во время собеседования.
word_family: size up
common_mistake: 'Size up' iborasi obyekt oladi va ajratilishi mumkin (masalan, size someone up).

definition_en: to make a problem, disagreement, or difficulty seem less serious or easier to manage
example_en: She tried to smooth over the disagreement between her colleagues before the meeting.
example_uz: U uchrashuv oldidan hamkasblari o'rtasidagi kelishmovchilikni silliqlashga harakat qildi.
example_ru: Она попыталась сгладить разногласия между коллегами перед собранием.
word_family: smooth over
common_mistake: 'Smooth' bu yerda fe'l bo'lib keladi va sirtni emas, balki mojarolarni yumshatishni bildiradi.

translation_ru: уходить в отставку, снимать свою кандидатуру
definition_en: to leave an official position or job so that someone else can take it
example_en: The chairman decided to stand down after ten years of leadership.
example_uz: Rais o'n yillik rahbarlikdan so'ng lavozimidan ketishga qaror qildi.
example_ru: Председатель решил уйти в отставку после десяти лет руководства.
word_family: stand down
common_mistake: 'Step down' bilan bir xil ma'noni beradi, ammo rasmiy vaziyatlarda ko'proq 'stand down' ishlatiladi.

definition_en: to direct all your attention or effort towards a particular topic, problem, or goal
example_en: The researchers need to zero in on the main cause of the problem.
example_uz: Tadqiqotchilar muammoning asosiy sababiga diqqat-e'tiborini qaratishlari kerak.
example_ru: Исследователям необходимо сосредоточить внимание на основной причине проблемы.
word_family: zero in on
common_mistake: Iborada ham 'in', ham 'on' predloglari birgalikda ishlatilishi shart.

definition_en: To give something to another person, especially after receiving it yourself or after using it.
example_en: Please read the memo and pass it on to your colleagues.
example_uz: Iltimos, ushbu xatni o'qib chiqing va uni hamkasblaringizga uzating.
example_ru: Пожалуйста, прочтите эту записку и передайте её своим коллегам.
word_family: pass on, passed on, passing on
common_mistake: Uzbek speakers often use 'give' instead of 'pass on' when referring to transferring information or objects down a chain of people.

definition_en: To write down information that someone is saying.
example_en: The secretary took down all the key details during the meeting.
example_uz: Kotib uchrashuv davomida barcha muhim tafsilotlarni yozib oldi.
example_ru: Секретарь записала все ключевые детали во время встречи.
word_family: take down, took down, taken down
common_mistake: Do not confuse 'take down' with 'take off', which means to remove clothing or for an aircraft to depart.

definition_en: To enter a building or vehicle by force, usually to steal something.
example_en: Someone tried to break into the office during the night.
example_uz: Tunda kimdir idoraga bostirib kirishga urindi.
example_ru: Ночью кто-то попытался вломиться в офис.
word_family: break into, broke into, broken into, break-in
common_mistake: 'Break into' is a transitive phrasal verb that takes its object directly without extra prepositions like 'in' (e.g. 'break into the house', not 'break into in the house').

definition_en: To return with something, or to make someone remember something from the past.
example_en: This old song brings back so many happy memories of my childhood.
example_uz: Ushbu eski qo'shiq bolaligimdagi ko'plab baxtli xotirlarni yodga soladi.
example_ru: Эта старая песня навевает столько счастливых воспоминаний о моём детстве.
word_family: bring back, brought back, bringing back
common_mistake: 'Bring back' implies returning something towards the current location or speaker, whereas 'take back' implies moving it away to its origin.

definition_en: To assemble the parts of something in order to build or make it.
example_en: It took us nearly two hours to put the new bookcase together.
example_uz: Yangi kitob javonini yig'ishimiz uchun deyarli ikki soat vaqt ketdi.
example_ru: У нас ушло почти два часа, чтобы собрать новый книжный шкаф.
word_family: put together, putting together
common_mistake: Learners sometimes confuse 'put together' with 'collect', which means gathering separate items rather than assembling components into one object.

definition_en: To return in the direction you came from, or to make someone do this.
example_en: The weather became so bad that the climbers had to turn back.
example_uz: Ob-havo shunchalik yomonlashdiki, alpinistlar ortga qaytishga majbur bo'lishdi.
example_ru: Погода настолько ухудшилась, что альпинистам пришлось повернуть назад.
word_family: turn back, turned back, turning back
common_mistake: Do not use 'turn back' when you simply mean turning your body or head around; use 'turn round' or 'turn around' instead.

definition_en: To stop someone or something from entering a place.
example_en: The sign on the fence said 'Keep Out - Private Property'.
example_uz: Devordagi belgilarda 'Kirish taqiqlanadi - xususiy mulk' deb yozilgan edi.
example_ru: На заборе была надпись «Вход воспрещён — частная собственность».
word_family: keep out, kept out, keeping out
common_mistake: On warning signs, 'keep out' is used as an imperative without an object, but when used transitively, an object must be inserted between 'keep' and 'out' (e.g. 'keep them out').

definition_en: To extend something towards someone, or to manage to survive or continue in a difficult situation.
example_en: She held out her hand to greet the visitor.
example_uz: U mehmonga salomlashish uchun qo'lini uzatdi.
example_ru: Она протянула руку, чтобы поприветствовать гостя.
word_family: hold out, held out, holding out
common_mistake: Do not confuse 'hold out' with 'hold on', which means to wait for a short period of time.

definition_en: To slowly disappear, become quieter, or lose strength over time.
example_en: The sound of the music slowly faded away into the distance.
example_uz: Musiqa ovozi uzoqlashib, sekin-asta yo'qolib bordi.
example_ru: Звук музыки медленно угас вдали.
word_family: fade away, faded away, fading away
common_mistake: 'Fade away' is an intransitive phrasal verb and cannot take a direct object.

definition_en: To offer help, information, or evidence to assist with a situation or investigation.
example_en: Police are asking any witnesses of the accident to come forward.
example_uz: Polisiya hodisa guvohlarini ma'lumot berish uchun oldinga chiqishga chaqirmoqda.
example_ru: Полиция просит всех свидетелей происшествия откликнуться и дать показания.
word_family: come forward, came forward, coming forward
common_mistake: 'Come forward' is intransitive; do not attach a direct object like 'come forward information'.

definition_en: To stop light, sound, or unpleasant memories from reaching you or coming into your mind.
example_en: Heavy curtains were used to block out the street light.
example_uz: Ko'cha chirog'ini to'sh uchun qalin pardalardan foydalanildi.
example_ru: Плотные шторы использовались, чтобы заслонить свет уличных фонарей.
word_family: block out, blocked out, blocking out
common_mistake: Using 'block' without 'out' generally refers to physically obstructing a path, whereas 'block out' specifically refers to screening out light, noise, or painful thoughts.

translation_uz: buzib tashlamoq, yer bilan yakson qilmoq
definition_en: To destroy or demolish a building or structure.
example_en: The old factory was pulled down to make room for new houses.
example_uz: Yangi uylar qurish uchun eski fabrika buzib tashlandi.
example_ru: Старую фабрику снесли, чтобы освободить место для новых домов.
word_family: pull down, pulled down, pulling down
common_mistake: Do not confuse 'pull down' with 'pull off', which means to succeed in doing something difficult or to detach something.

definition_en: to recover quickly from a setback, illness, or difficult situation
example_en: The company managed to bounce back after a difficult financial year.
example_uz: Kompaniya qiyin moliyaviy yildan so'ng qayta tiklanishga erishdi.
example_ru: Компания сумела восстановиться после трудного финансового года.
word_family: bounce back (v)
common_mistake: 'Bounce back' ko'pincha ruhiy yoki moliyaviy tiklanish uchun ishlatiladi; uni har doim ham jismoniy narsalarning sakrashiga nisbatan ishlatib bo'lmaydi.

definition_en: to produce something to sell to the public or make something noticeable
example_en: The publisher plans to bring out a new edition of the dictionary next year.
example_uz: Nashriyot kelasi yili lug'atning yangi nashrini chiqarishni rejalashtirmoqda.
example_ru: Издательство планирует выпустить новое издание словаря в следующем году.
word_family: bring out (v)
common_mistake: 'Bring out' va 'take out'ni adashtirmang; 'bring out' yangi mahsulot yoki kitobni sotuvga chiqarishni anglatadi.

definition_en: to suddenly start producing something, such as tears, laughter, or song
example_en: The young child burst into tears after dropping his ice cream on the pavement.
example_uz: Yosh bola muzqaymog'ini yo'lakka tushirib yuborgach, to'satdan yig'lab yubordi.
example_ru: Маленький ребенок разразился слезами, уронив мороженое на тротуар.
word_family: burst into (v)
common_mistake: 'Burst into tears' birikmasida 'into' o'rniga 'in' ishlatish xatodir.

definition_en: to examine someone or something carefully to make sure everything is correct or healthy
example_en: The mechanic agreed to check over the car before our long journey.
example_uz: Mexanik uzoq safarimizdan oldin mashinani diqqat bilan tekshirib berishga rozi bo'ldi.
example_ru: Механик согласился тщательно проверить машину перед нашей долгой поездкой.
word_family: check over (v)
common_mistake: 'Check over' va 'check out' farqlanadi; 'check over' nuqson yoki xatolarni topish uchun sinchiklab tekshirishni anglatadi.

definition_en: to regain consciousness, or to change one's opinion to agree with someone
example_en: He was opposed to the proposal at first, but he eventually came round.
example_uz: U boshida taklifga qarshi edi, lekin oxir-bo'lib fikrini o'zgartirdi.
example_ru: Сначала он был против предложения, но в конце концов изменил свое мнение.
word_family: come round (v)
common_mistake: Amerika ingliz tilida ko'pincha 'come around' shakli ishlatiladi, britancha shakli 'come round'.

definition_en: to become cooler in temperature or to become calmer after being angry
example_en: Let your bowl of soup cool down before you start eating it.
example_uz: Sho'rva ichishni boshlashdan oldin uning sovishini kuting.
example_ru: Дайте супу остыть, прежде чем начать есть.
word_family: cool down (v), cool-down (n)
common_mistake: Insonning jahli chiqib tinchlanishi uchun 'cool down' iborasi ham to'g'ri keladi.

definition_en: to manage or survive without having a particular thing or person
example_en: During the power outage, we had to do without electricity for two days.
example_uz: Chiroq o'chgan paytda biz ikki kun davomida elektr energiyasisiz amallashimizga to'g'ri keldi.
example_ru: Во время отключения света нам пришлось обходиться без электричества два дня.
word_family: do without (v)
common_mistake: 'Do without' fe'lidan keyin nimadan vos kechilganini bildiruvchi to'ldiruvchi (masalan: 'it') kelishi shart.

definition_en: to use something as a secondary option or support when other plans fail
example_en: If her job application fails, she has her savings to fall back on.
example_uz: Agar uning ishga kirish arizasi rad etilsa, suyanishi uchun jamg'argan pullari bor.
example_ru: Если ее заявление о приеме на работу отклонят, у нее есть сбережения, на которые можно рассчитывать.
synonyms: resort to, rely on, turn to
word_family: fall back on (v)
common_mistake: Ushbu iborada oxirgi 'on' predlogini tushirib qoldirmang; to'g'ri shakli 'fall back on'.

definition_en: to gradually become less close or friendly with someone over time
example_en: After leaving university, the two close friends slowly began to grow apart.
example_uz: Universitetni tugatgach, ikki yaqin do'st sekin-asta bir-biridan uzoqlasha boshladi.
example_ru: После окончания университета два близких друга постепенно начали отдаляться друг от друга.
word_family: grow apart (v)
common_mistake: 'Grow apart' fe'li odatda ko'plikdagi shaxslarga nisbatan qo'llaniladi (we grew apart, they grew apart).

definition_en: to delay doing something or delay taking action
example_en: They decided to hold off buying a new home until interest rates decreased.
example_uz: Ular foiz stavkalari pasayguncha yangi uy sotib olishni kechiktirishga qaror qilishdi.
example_ru: Они решили отложить покупку нового дома до снижения процентных ставок.
word_family: hold off (v)
common_mistake: 'Hold off'dan keyin fe'l kelsa, u har doim -ing shaklida bo'ladi ('hold off buying', 'hold off to buy' emas).

definition_en: to avoid going near someone or something, or to prevent someone from going near
example_en: You should keep away from the construction site for your own safety.
example_uz: O'z xavfsizligingiz uchun qurilish maydonchasidan uzoqroq turishingiz kerak.
example_ru: Вам следует держаться подальше от строительной площадки ради вашей безопасности.
synonyms: avoid, stay clear of, keep clear
word_family: keep away (v)
common_mistake: Biror ob'ektdan uzoq durishda 'keep away' ko'pincha 'from' predlogi bilan ishlatiladi.

definition_en: to achieve a high standard or fulfill expected requirements or promises
example_en: The hotel was very comfortable and fully lived up to our expectations.
example_uz: Mehmonxona juda qulay edi va bizning umidlarimizni to'liq oqladi.
example_ru: Отель был очень комфортным и полностью оправдал наши ожидания.
word_family: live up to (v)
common_mistake: Ushbu fe'lda 'up' va 'to' birga keladi; 'live to expectations' deyish xatodir.

definition_en: to behave badly or fail to function properly
example_en: My old car's engine started to act up on the way home.
example_uz: Uyga qaytish yo'lida eski mashinamning dvigateli buzila boshladi.
example_ru: По дороге домой двигатель моей старой машины начал барахлить.
word_family: act, acting
common_mistake: Do not use 'act up' to mean 'imitate someone'. It specifically means misbehaving or malfunctioning.

translation_ru: пойти на попятную, отказаться от обещания
definition_en: to decide not to do something that you had agreed to do
example_en: He signed the agreement and couldn't back out later.
example_uz: U shartnomani imzoladi va keyinchalik undan voz kecha olmadi.
example_ru: Он подписал соглашение и не мог потом пойти на попятную.
word_family: back, backing
common_mistake: Do not confuse 'back out' (withdraw from an agreement) with 'back up' (support or reverse a vehicle).

translation_uz: yangi sohani yo'lga qo'ymoq, faoliyatini kengaytirmoq
definition_en: to start doing a new activity or business, especially one related to your existing work
example_en: The company decided to branch out into software development.
example_uz: Kompaniya dasturiy ta'minot ishlab chiqish sohasini ham yo'lga qo'yishga qaror qildi.
example_ru: Компания решила расширить свою деятельность и заняться разработкой программного обеспечения.
word_family: branch, branching
common_mistake: 'Branch out' requires the preposition 'into' when introducing a new field of work.

definition_en: to abruptly stop speaking or end a relationship, agreement, or discussion
example_en: They decided to break off diplomatic relations after the negotiations failed.
example_uz: Muzokaralar muvaffaqiyatsiz tugagach, ular diplomatik munosabatlarni uzishga qaror qilishdi.
example_ru: Они решили разорвать дипломатические отношения после провала переговоров.
word_family: break, broken, breakage
common_mistake: Use 'break off' for ending talks or relations, whereas 'break up' usually refers to romantic relationships.

definition_en: to persuade someone to agree with you, or to make someone conscious again
example_en: It took a long time to bring her round to our point of view.
example_uz: Uni bizning nuqtai nazarimizga ko'ndirish uchun ko'p vaqt ketdi.
example_ru: Потребовалось много времени, чтобы склонить её к нашей точке зрения.
word_family: bring, brought
common_mistake: In British English, 'bring round' is standard, whereas American English prefers 'bring around'.

definition_en: to refuse to listen to someone or dismiss a suggestion rudely
example_en: She tried to offer advice, but he just brushed her off.
example_uz: U maslahat bermoqchi bo'ldi, lekin u shunchaki uni e'tiborsiz qoldirdi.
example_ru: Она попыталась дать совет, но он просто отмахнулся от неё.
word_family: brush, brushing
common_mistake: Do not confuse 'brush off' (dismiss someone) with 'brush up on' (revise or improve knowledge).

definition_en: to consume completely by fire, or to expend energy or calories rapidly
example_en: Running on a treadmill helps to burn up extra calories.
example_uz: Yugurish yo'lakchasida yugurish ortiqcha kaloriyalarni sarflashga yordam beradi.
example_ru: Бег на беговой дорожке помогает сжигать лишние калории.
word_family: burn, burning, burnt
common_mistake: Do not confuse 'burn up' with 'burn out' (which means to become exhausted through overwork).

definition_en: to interrupt a conversation or activity rudely without being invited
example_en: It is impolite to butt in while other people are talking.
example_uz: Boshqa odamlar gaplashayotganda gapga suqulish odabsizlikdir.
example_ru: Вмешиваться, когда говорят другие люди, вежливо не принято.
word_family: butt, butts
common_mistake: Do not use 'to' directly after 'butt in'; use 'butt in on [a conversation]'.

definition_en: to speak loudly or criticize someone publicly for doing something wrong
example_en: The journalist called out the politician for spreading false information.
example_uz: Jurnalist siyosatchini yolg'on ma'lumot tarqatgani uchun oshkora tanqid qildi.
example_ru: Журналист открыто раскритиковал политика за распространение ложной информации.
word_family: call, calling
common_mistake: When meaning 'to criticize', 'call out' requires an object (e.g. 'call someone out for something').

definition_en: to create or establish something, such as a career or niche, through hard work
example_en: She managed to carve out a successful career in international finance.
example_uz: U xalqaro moliya sohasida muvaffaqiyatli martaba barpo etishga erishdi.
example_ru: Ей удалось построить успешную карьеру в сфере международных финансов.
word_family: carve, carving
common_mistake: 'Carve out' typically collocates with words like 'career', 'niche', or 'reputation'.

definition_en: to find or see someone or something unexpectedly by luck or accident
example_en: While walking through the old town, we chanced upon a charming little café.
example_uz: Eski shahar bo'ylab sayr qilib yurganda, biz tasodifan mitti shinam qahvaxonaga duch keldik.
example_ru: Прогуливаясь по старому городу, мы случайно наткнулись на милое маленькое кафе.
synonyms: stumble upon, happen upon, come across
word_family: chance, chancing
common_mistake: 'Chance upon' is slightly formal; use 'come across' in informal everyday speech.

definition_en: to suppress or hide strong emotion, such as tears, anger, or sadness
example_en: She had to choke back her tears during the sad farewell ceremony.
example_uz: U ma'yus xayrlashuv marosimi davomida ko'z yoshlarini ichiga yutishga majbur bo'ldi.
example_ru: Ей пришлось сдерживать слезы во время печальной церемонии прощания.
word_family: choke, choking
common_mistake: 'Choke back' is specifically used with emotions or physical expressions of emotion like tears or sobs.

definition_en: to read or look at something very quickly
example_en: She glanced through the report before the meeting started.
example_uz: U majlis boshlanishidan oldin hisobotni tezda koʻzdan kechirib chiqdi.
example_ru: Она бегло просмотрела отчёт перед началом собрания.
word_family: glance
common_mistake: 'Glance through' iborasidan keyin 'at' predlogini qoʻshib 'glance through at' deyish xatodir; shunchaki 'glance through something' ishlatiladi.

translation_ru: погрузиться в, с энтузиазмом взяться за
definition_en: to start doing something with energy and enthusiasm
example_en: After a short break, he dived into his work again.
example_uz: Qisqa tanaffusdan soʻng u yana gʻayrat bilan ishga kirishdi.
example_ru: После короткого перерыва он снова с энтузиазмом погрузился в работу.
word_family: dive, diver, diving
common_mistake: Ushbu iboradan soʻng ot yoki fe'lning '-ing' shakli keladi; masalan, 'dive into reading' koʻrinishida qoʻllaniladi.

definition_en: to pass or disappear without serious consequences
example_en: Don't worry about the scandal; it will soon blow over.
example_uz: Xavotir olmang, bu janjal tez orada oʻtib ketadi.
example_ru: Не волнуйтесь из-за скандала; он скоро утихнет.
word_family: blow, blown
common_mistake: 'Blow over' odatda muammo yoki dovul oʻzi bosilishini bildiradi, uni oʻtmanli fe'l sifatida toʻldiruvchi bilan ishlatish xatodir.

translation_uz: yon bermoq, rozi boʻlishga majbur boʻlmoq
definition_en: to agree to something after refusing or resisting
example_en: The management finally caved in to the workers' demands.
example_uz: Rahbariyat oxir-oqibat ishchilarning talablariga yon berdi.
example_ru: Руководство в конце концов уступило требованиям рабочих.
word_family: cave
common_mistake: Birovning talabiga yon berishda 'cave in to' formasida 'to' predlogi qoʻllaniladi, 'for' yoki 'with' emas.

definition_en: to encourage someone to do something foolish or dangerous
example_en: His friends egged him on to jump into the cold river.
example_uz: Doʻstlari uni sovuq daryoga sakrashga gij-gijlashdi.
example_ru: Друзья подбили его прыгнуть в холодную реку.
common_mistake: Bu ibora 'egg' (tuxum) otiga bogʻliq emas va oʻrtasida toʻldiruvchi keladi: 'egg someone on'.

translation_ru: выработать, согласовать в ходе долгих обсуждений
definition_en: to reach an agreement after detailed or difficult discussions
example_en: The two countries managed to hammer out a new trade agreement.
example_uz: Ikki mamlakat yangi savdo bitimini uzoq muhokamadan soʻng kelishib olishga muvaffaq boʻldi.
example_ru: Двум странам удалось выработать новое торговое соглашение.
word_family: hammer
common_mistake: 'Hammer out' biror narsani jismonan bolgʻalashni emas, aksincha uzoq bahslar evaziga kelishuvga erishishni anglatadi.

definition_en: to remain cheerful and strong during a difficult time
example_en: How is she bearing up after the sad news?
example_uz: U bu gʻamli xabardan keyin oʻzini qanday tutyapti, bardosh beryaptimi?
example_ru: Как она держится после таких печальных новостей?
word_family: bear, borne
common_mistake: Ushbu fe'l oʻzi toʻldiruvchi olmaydi, shuning uchun 'bear up something' deb ishlatilmaydi.

definition_en: to begin to understand or realize something
example_en: It took him a while to cotton on to what they were planning.
example_uz: Ular nima rejalashtirayotganini tushunib yetishi uchun unga biroz vaqt kerak boʻldi.
example_ru: Ему потребовалось некоторое время, чтобы понять, что они планируют.
common_mistake: Biror narsani tushunib yetishda 'cotton on to something' birikmasi ishlatiladi, 'cotton on about' emas.

definition_en: to discuss a situation or problem thoroughly before making a decision
example_en: We need to talk over the proposal before signing the contract.
example_uz: Shartnomani imzolashdan oldin taklifni muhokama qilib olishimiz kerak.
example_ru: Нам нужно обсудить предложение перед подписанием контракта.
word_family: talk over
common_mistake: O'zbek tilidagi 'haqida gaplashmoq' ma'nosi tufayli 'talk over about' deyish xato; 'talk over' dan so'ng 'about' ishlatilmaydi.

definition_en: to give something to someone else formally or officially
example_en: The outgoing manager agreed to hand over all the duties by Friday.
example_uz: Lavozimidan ketayotgan menejer juma kuniga qadar barcha vazifalarni topshirishga rozi bo'ldi.
example_ru: Уходящий менеджер согласился передать все обязанности к пятнице.
word_family: handover
common_mistake: Ot shaklida 'handover' birga yoziladi, ammo fe'l birikmasi bo'lganda 'hand over' deb ajratib yoziladi.

definition_en: to express support for a person, team, or cause
example_en: Everyone in the office is rooting for you during your interview today.
example_uz: Bugungi suhbatingiz davomida idoradagi barcha sizga muxlislik qilmoqda.
example_ru: Все в офисе болеют за вас во время сегодняшнего собеседования.
word_family: rooting
common_mistake: 'Root for' iborasi doimo 'for' predlogi bilan ishlatiladi, predlogni tushirib qoldirish xatodir.

definition_en: to make something less forceful, harsh, or offensive
example_en: The editor advised the journalist to tone down her aggressive language.
example_uz: Muarrir jurnalistga uning tajovuzkor tilini biroz yumshatishni maslahat berdi.
example_ru: Редактор посоветовал журналистке смягчить её резкие высказывания.
word_family: toned down
common_mistake: 'Tone down' shaxsning o'zini emas, balki uning matni, nutqi yoki xulq-atvorini bosingqiroq qilishda qo'llaniladi.

definition_en: to prevent unsuitable people or things from being accepted or included
example_en: The hiring software helps screen out unqualified candidates automatically.
example_uz: Ishga qabul qilish dasturi munosib bo'lmagan nomzodlarni avtomatik ravishda saralab olib tashlashga yordam beradi.
example_ru: Программа по найму помогает автоматически отсеивать неквалифицированных кандидатов.
word_family: screening
common_mistake: 'Screen out' rad etish yoki o'tkazmaslikni bildiradi; saralab qabul qilish uchun shunchaki 'screen' ishlatiladi.

definition_en: to give someone secret information or a warning about something
example_en: An anonymous caller tipped off the police about the planned robbery.
example_uz: Noma'lum qo'ng'iroq qiluvchi militsiyaga rejalashtirilgan o'g'rilik haqida yashirincha xabar berdi.
example_ru: Анонимный абонент предупредил полицию о планируемом ограблении.
word_family: tip-off
common_mistake: Fe'l birikmasi 'tip off' ajratib yoziladi, chiziqcha bilan yozilgan 'tip-off' esa faqat ot hisoblanadi.

definition_en: to enter information into a computer or digital device using a keyboard
example_en: Please key in your personal identification number to proceed with the transaction.
example_uz: O'tkazmani davom ettirish uchun shaxsiy identifikatsiya raqamingizni klaviaturada kiriting.
example_ru: Пожалуйста, введите ваш персональный идентификационный номер, чтобы продолжить транзакцию.
word_family: keying in
common_mistake: Raqamli moslamalarga ma'lumot kiritishda 'write in' emas, 'key in' yoki 'type in' ishlatilishi to'g'ri bo'ladi.

definition_en: to make a careless or foolish mistake
example_en: If you slip up on the final details, the entire project could fail.
example_uz: So'nggi tafsilotlarda xatoga yo'l qo'sangiz, butun loyiha muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchrashi mumkin.
example_ru: Если вы оступитесь в финальных деталях, весь проект может провалиться.
word_family: slip-up
